title: Late Charges on Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease Units under Written Termination Notice
content:
# Billing Terms — Late Charges on Units under Written Termination Notice, Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease

**Term.** For the late charge on a unit's most recent rental invoice month under the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease, the charge after the minimum is multiplied by the late-charge wind-down multiplier: 0.75 where the written termination notice for the unit was received before the invoice date and the unit has since been turned in, 0.90 where the notice was received before the invoice date and the unit has not been turned in, and 1 where no termination notice was received before the invoice date.

**Records read.** The termination notice date and turn-in date the unit records, and the invoice date of the unit's most recent rental invoice. "Before the invoice date" means on an earlier calendar day; a notice dated the same day as the invoice was not received before it.

## Combinations

| Termination notice date on the unit | Turn-in date recorded on the unit | Wind-down multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| earlier than the invoice date | recorded | 0.75 |
| earlier than the invoice date | none | 0.90 |
| same day as, or later than, the invoice date | any | 1 |
| no termination notice recorded | any | 1 |

## Cases (hypothetical)

1. Notice received on the 20th of one month, invoice dated the 1st of the next, unit turned in on the 25th of that next month: 0.75. A charge after the minimum of 40.00 becomes 30.00.
2. Same notice and invoice, unit not yet turned in: 0.90; 40.00 becomes 36.00.
3. Notice received on the invoice date itself: 1.
